verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that AnythingLLM lets users build their own agent skills, through a custom skill developer guide and no-code Agent Flows. It shows nothing about a published community ecosystem: no hub or marketplace, no counts of shared skills, plugins or presets, and no evidence of active maintainers. Building blocks for creating skills do not show that a living ecosystem exists, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power user, the community ecosystem is genuinely alive — thousands of published skills, plugins, or presets with active maintainers
